#!make
include .env
export $(shell sed 's/=.*//' .env)

setup: init-submodule build-docker-dev-images install-fe-dependencies

clean: stop recover-submodule clean-storage clean-fe
clean-be:
	sudo rm -rf ${PWD}/src/be/target ${PWD}/src/be/logs
clean-fe:
	sudo rm -rf ${PWD}/src/fe/dist ${PWD}/src/fe/node_modules
clean-storage:
	sudo rm -rf ${PWD}/storage
	git clean -fd
clean-db:
	sudo rm -rf ${PWD}/storage/mysql
clean-postgres-db:
	sudo rm -rf ${PWD}/storage/postgres
start: copy-application-yaml copy-fe-configs
	docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
stop: clean-be
	docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down
restart: stop start

start-prod:
	docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
stop-prod:
	docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down
restart-prod: stop-prod start-prod

build-docker-dev-images:
	docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml build

init-submodule:
	git submodule init
	git submodule update
recover-submodule:
	git submodule deinit -f -- src/be
	git submodule deinit -f -- src/fe
	git submodule update --init
	#sudo git clean -fd src/be
	#sudo git clean -fd src/fe

install-fe-dependencies:
	docker run -ti --rm -e http_proxy=${http_proxy} -e https_proxy=${https_proxy} -e no_proxy=${no_proxy} -v ${PWD}/src/fe:/fe -w /fe dev-dashboard-ui:dev npm install

copy-application-yaml:
	cp ${PWD}/config/be/dev/application.dev.yaml ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/resources/application.yaml
copy-fe-configs:
	cp ${PWD}/config/fe/dev/proxy.conf.json ${PWD}/src/fe/proxy.docker.conf.json
	cp ${PWD}/config/fe/dev/environment.local.ts ${PWD}/src/fe/src/environments/environment.local.ts

fetch-src:
	git submodule update --remote
fetch-remote-db:
	#docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/config/mysql:/root/temp mysql:5.7 mysqldump --default-character-set utf8 -h ${REMOTE_MYSQL_HOST} -u${REMOTE_MYSQL_USER} -p${REMOTE_MYSQL_PASSWORD} -d ${REMOTE_MYSQL_DATABASE} -r /root/temp/schema.sql
	docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/config/mysql:/root/temp mysql:5.7 mysqldump --default-character-set utf8 -h ${REMOTE_MYSQL_HOST} -u${REMOTE_MYSQL_USER} -p${REMOTE_MYSQL_PASSWORD} ${REMOTE_MYSQL_DATABASE} -r /root/temp/staging.sql
fetch-remote-db-prod:
	docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/config/mysql:/root/temp mysql:5.7 mysqldump --default-character-set utf8 -h ${REMOTE_MYSQL_HOST} -u${REMOTE_MYSQL_USER} -p${REMOTE_MYSQL_PASSWORD} -d ${REMOTE_MYSQL_DATABASE} -r /root/temp/schema.sql
	sed -i 's/DROP.*//g' ${PWD}/config/mysql/schema.sql
fetch-remote-postgres-db:
	docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/config/postgres:/root/temp -e PGPASSWORD=${REMOTE_POSTGRES_PASSWORD} postgres:12.3 pg_dump -v -d ${REMOTE_POSTGRES_DATABASE} -h ${REMOTE_POSTGRES_HOST} -U ${REMOTE_POSTGRES_USER} -f /root/temp/postgres.sql

add-git-remote:
	cd ${PWD}/src/fe && git remote add fork git@host-cfacda0c.example.com:${GITHUB_USER}/dev-dashboard-ui.git && git fetch fork
	cd ${PWD}/src/be && git remote add fork git@host-cfacda0c.example.com:${GITHUB_USER}/dev-dashboard.git && git fetch fork

build-fe-prod: install-fe-dependencies
	# Replace environment.ts
	cp ${PWD}/config/fe/prod/environment.prod.ts ${PWD}/src/fe/src/environments/environment.prod.ts
	# Replace index.html
	#cp ${PWD}/config/fe/prod/index.html ${PWD}/src/fe/src/index.html
	#docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/src/fe:/fe -w /fe node:6-slim node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build --deploy-url resource/ --output-hashing all
	docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/src/fe:/fe -w /fe dev-dashboard-ui:dev node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng build --prod --deploy-url resource/ --output-hashing all
build-be-prod: build-fe-prod
	rm -rf ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/resources/static/resource/*
	cp -r ${PWD}/src/fe/dist/* ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/resources/static/resource/
	# Remove script include secrets
	rm -rf ${PWD}/src/be/backup_db.sh
	rm -rf ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/resources/*.yaml
	# Copy application.yaml
	cp ${PWD}/config/be/prod/application.prod.yaml ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/resources/application.yaml
	# Temp
	#cp ${PWD}/config/be/prod/DashboardApplication.java ${PWD}/src/be/src/main/java/com/samsung/dashboard/
	#cp ${PWD}/config/be/prod/pom.xml ${PWD}/src/be/
	docker run -ti --rm -v ${PWD}/src/be:/root -v ${PWD}/storage/backend/m2:/root/.m2 -w /root maven:3.3.9 mvn clean package -DskipTests=true
build-prod: build-be-prod
	# Copy war and sql
	cp ${PWD}/src/be/target/devdashboard-0.1.war ${PWD}/config/be/prod/
	cp ${PWD}/config/mysql/schema.sql ${PWD}/config/be/prod/
	# Build docker image
	docker build -t art.sec.samsung.net/rs7-swcdashboard_docker/dboard:${IMAGE_TAG} -f config/be/prod/Dockerfile.prod config/be/prod --build-arg http_proxy=${http_proxy} --build-arg https_proxy=${https_proxy}
